==Summary==
:{{pov|[[Perrin Aybara]]}}

The group rides for days, with winter changing into spring as they descend from the mountains. [[Perrin Aybara|Perrin]] knows wolves are nearby but keeps his mind closed to them. [[Lan]] rides ahead of the others, leaving signs behind to indicate the path they should follow. Moiraine complains that Lan is moving too slowly and makes a snide remark about sending him to [[Myrelle Berengari|Myrelle]].{{ref|Should Moiraine die, she has arranged for Myrelle to inherit Lan's bond. {{2|22}}}} [[Moiraine]] has the [[Dragon Banner]] that [[Rand]] left behind.

Often Perrin and [[Loial]] catch mountain trout in streams for their food. One day Moiraine is interested and they show her how they grab the trout with their hands. Perrin does not expect Moiraine to succeed but she immediately catches three, the biggest ones Perrin has ever seen.{{ref|Moiraine must have immobilized the trout with [[Air]] or [[Water]] before grabbing them.}} Perrin is upset that Moiraine will not take her turn at the chores. Perrin does not want Moiraine to run his life, yet he finds himself manipulated into doing every little thing for her despite his wishes. They enter [[Ghealdan]] and begin to see cleared land and farms. They finally come upon the village of [[Jarra]].
